decisions.reason: As a narrowly focused web-map add-on that disappeared from the website after its 2018 launch, it likely lacked enough strategic or commercial weight as a standalone product and is better folded into the core portfolio or replaced by newer developments.

A platform for building GIS solutions is highly consistent with the firm's integrated enterprise geospatial strategy and became more prominently presented, which signals strategic importance and continuing market relevance.
Mobile field data capture fits well with customer needs for operational geodata workflows and remained actively presented, so it should continue as part of the firm's solution portfolio.
The search extension stayed visible and received a version update, indicating ongoing maintenance and demand in the firm's established web-mapping business.
